contract: Serial arithmetic decoding from ITU-T H.264 9.3.3.2 and H.265 9.3.4.3, with authored bin strings encoded by dyadic interval selection.

Compare every decision, context transition, bypass value, termination, restart, refusal and input byte. Compare the logical bit cursor, aligned byte position and target-dependent look-ahead cursor after each call. A capped unary read stops at its limit without consuming a following bin.

open_cases.requirement: A limit of three must advance three bypass bins. The candidate consumes 8 bins, changing the cursor and the next bypass value.
